fields.name: dwException
fields.description: One member of the SIMCONNECT_EXCEPTION enumeration type, indicating which error has occurred.

fields.name: dwSendID
fields.description: The ID of the packet that contained the error, see Remarks below.

fields.name: dwIndex
fields.description: The index number (starting at 1) of the first parameter that caused an error. Special case: UNKNOWN_INDEX = 0.

fields.name: dwRequestID
fields.description: The ID of the client defined request.

fields.name: dwObjectID
fields.description: The ID of the client defined object.

fields.name: dwDefineID
fields.description: The ID of the client defined data definition.

fields.name: dwFlags
fields.description: The flags that were set for this data request, see SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObject for a description of the flags. This parameter will always be set to zero if the call was SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObjectType.

fields.name: dwentrynumber
fields.description: If multiple objects are being returned, this is the index number of this object out of a total of dwoutof. This will always be 1 if the call was SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObject, and can be 0 or more if the call was SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObjectType.

fields.name: dwoutof
fields.description: The total number of objects being returned. Note that dwentrynumber and dwoutof start with 1 not 0, so if two objects are being returned dwentrynumber and dwoutof pairs will be 1,2 and 2,2 for the two objects. This will always be 1 if the call was SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObject, and can be 0 or more if the call was SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObjectType.

fields.name: dwDefineCount
fields.description: The number of 8-byte elements in the dwData array.

fields.name: dwData
fields.description: A data array containing information on a specified object in 8-byte (double word) elements. The length of the array is dwDefineCount.

fields.name: dwRequestID
fields.description: Double word containing the client defined request ID.

fields.name: dwObjectID
fields.description: Double word containing the server defined object ID.

fields.name: uGroupID
fields.description: The ID of the client defined group, or the special case value: UNKNOWN_GROUP (which equals DWORD_MAX).

fields.name: uEventID
fields.description: The ID of the client defined event that has been requested (such as EVENT_1 or EVENT_BRAKES).

fields.name: dwData
fields.description: This value is usually zero, but some events require further qualification. For example, joystick movement events require a movement value in addition to the notification that the joystick has been moved (see SimConnect_MapInputEventToClientEvent for more information).

fields.name: szChoiceReserved[30]
fields.description: Null-terminated string containing the key that has been reserved. This will be identical to the string entered as one of the choices for the SimConnect_RequestReservedKey function.

fields.name: szReservedKey[50]
fields.description: Null-terminated string containing the reserved key combination. This will be an uppercase string containing all the modifiers that apply. For example, if the client program requests "q", and the choice is accepted, then this parameter will contain "TAB+Q". If the client program requests "Q", then this parameter will contain "SHIFT+TAB+Q". This string could then appear, for example, in a dialog from the client application, informing a user of the appropriate help key.

fields.name: dwRequestID
fields.description: Double word containing the client defined request ID.

fields.name: dwArraySize
fields.description: Double word containing the number of elements in the list that are within this packet. For example, if there are 25 airports returned in the SIMCONNECT_RECV_AIRPORT_LIST structure, then this field will contain 25, but if there are 400 airports in the list and the data is returned in two packets, then this value will contain the number of entries within each packet.

fields.name: dwEntryNumber
fields.description: Double word containing the index number of this list packet. This number will be from 0 to dwOutOf - 1.

fields.name: dwOutOf
fields.description: Double word containing the total number of packets used to transmit the list.

fields.name: Flags
fields.description: Flags indicating whether the other fields are valid or not. SIMCONNECT_RECV_ID_VOR_LIST_HAS_NAV_SIGNAL(0x1): Set if the station has a NAV transmitter, and if so, GlideLat, GlideLon and GlideAlt contain valid data. SIMCONNECT_RECV_ID_VOR_LIST_HAS_LOCALIZER(0x2): Set if the station transmits an ILS localizer angle, and if so fLocalizer contains valid data. SIMCONNECT_RECV_ID_VOR_LIST_HAS_GLIDE_SLOPE(0x4): Set if the station transmits an ILS approach angle, and if so fGlideSlopeAngle contains valid data. SIMCONNECT_RECV_ID_VOR_LIST_HAS_DME(0x8): Set if the station t transmits a DME signal, and if so the inherited DME fFrequency contains valid data.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: String that contains the values, separated by ;. Values can be: char[260] FLOAT64

fields.description: Specifies the client defined request ID.

fields.description: One member of the SIMCONNECT_INPUT_EVENT_TYPE enumeration type. This is used to cast the Value to the correct type.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: The value of the requested input event, which should be cast to the correct format (float / string).

fields.name: Hash
fields.description: Hash ID that will identify the subscribed input event.

fields.description: The name of the Input Event.

fields.description: The hash ID for the event.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: The expected datatype (from the SIMCONNECT_DATATYPE enum). Usually a FLOAT32 or STRING128.

fields.name: NodeNames
fields.description: A list of the names of the nodes linked to this InputEvent, where each node name is separated by a ;.

fields.name: DeviceName

fields.name: DeviceId
fields.description: The device ID.

fields.name: ProductId
